projectile_base.status: VERIFIED (field use and movement traced; damage reproduced exactly)
projectile_base.ctor: 0x08019B04 base(obj, gfx_id, owner): vtable, +0x0C sprite slot, +0x0E gfx id, +0x10 dir = owner+0x10, +0x11 = owner+0x1D0, +0x14 = 0, +0x1C = owner
projectile_base.box_update: 0x08019B4E: x0 = (x>>8) - ox, y0 = (y>>8) - oy, x1 = x0 + w, y1 = y0 + h -> +0x28..+0x34; +0x04 = y>>8 (sort key). Box def = s8 ox, s8 oy, u8 w, u8 h, u32 OAM attrs, ptr gfx (12 bytes)

fields.+0x18: box/frame def pointer (table + 12*dir, stepped +-0x30 for animation)
fields.+0x1C: owner enemy (cleared by message 0x11/0x12 when the owner dies -> no more damage)

projectile_base.spawning: controller frame N: needs 0x080116FC(world) >= 0x80 (pool room; some 0x100/0x400/0x700/0x1400), builder(0, &muzzle_xy, dir, owner) then 0x0801191A(world 0x03001C4C, obj). muzzle = enemy pixel position + per-dir (dx,dy) from the spawn-data block
projectile_base.removal: no lifetime timer for straight shots: removed when the box leaves the camera rect at 0x030019BC (240x160 view), explodes when any 8x8 tile under the box is blocked in the projectile passability bitmap [0x03001A50] (0x08009324) or the box leaves 0..2048, and explodes/vanishes when a hit lands
projectile_base.hit_message: 0x08011C70(world, 0, msg) / 0x08011C0C / 0x08011CCA: msg+0 u8 kind (0 attack, 2 explosion), +4..+0x10 box, +0x14 hit struct {u8 dir, u32 mult (0x400=1.0), attack type ptr, attacker=owner}, +0x30 sender. The player handler runs ComputeDamage(player, hit)
projectile_base.vs_player_attacks: bullets, rifle shots, shuriken, tank shells: a player attack message (kind 0) whose box overlaps destroys them (their vfunc +0x24) - INFERRED from code; energy waves only when the attack comes head-on (msg dir == wave dir ^ 1) and overlaps the head +-12 px
projectile_base.block: normal block rule: R held and (hit dir ^ 1) == player facing -> damage x 1/16 (0x1000>>16)
projectile_base.iframes: during the player hurt state (24 frames) resist = 0 -> damage 0, the projectile is still consumed
